candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: LIDAR Composite First Return Digital Surface Model (FZ_DSM) - 1m
verified_facts: The 1m first-return DSM uses the first or only laser pulse and includes vehicles, buildings and vegetation as well as terrain where the first return is ground.
It is derived from National LIDAR Programme data captured from November 2016 to May 2022 and uses feathering across survey overlaps.
Its coverage and extent need not match the last-return DSM composite because the source survey populations differ.
The data is aligned to the OS National Grid, referenced to Ordnance Survey Newlyn, uses OSTN15 and individual input surveys had +/-15cm RMSE vertical accuracy.
semantic_limits: First-return DSM elevations are not bare-earth ground elevations and cannot silently replace DTM parcel-height samples even when nominal resolution and RMSE appear similar.

candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: National LIDAR Programme survey data
verified_facts: EA states manual filtering is undertaken on the DTM to improve automated classification and produce a most likely ground surface model.
Areas of no data such as water bodies are filled to avoid gaps in the model.
First Return DSM contains ground and surface objects and is more likely to return elevations near tree tops and building edges.
The National LIDAR Programme dataset period extends through 5 May 2023 and exposes coverage metadata for survey lineage.
semantic_limits: Processing semantics and coverage metadata are QA evidence only; they do not authorize substituting a different survey or surface product for the SHA-bound sampled DTM.
